stage: Studio now reuses the runtime's quest transition validator
the_gap: my quest projection checked stages, objectives, texts, rules and policies, but never TRANSITIONS - the compiler checks them (ContentCompiler calls QuestLifecycleReducer.TransitionProblems) and Studio did not, so a quest could pass Studio and fail compilation
the_fix: QuestStructure now calls the same QuestLifecycleReducer.TransitionProblems the compiler calls, so the two cannot drift: one set of rules, one implementation. No second rule table was written
what_it_catches: a transition targeting an unknown stage
a transition naming an unknown objective
a stage or transition id defined twice
the_campaign_today: the authored quests declare FIFTEEN stages and ZERO transitions, so the reuse changes no current verdict - it closes the hole before the first transition is written, which is exactly when a directional quest would need one
